description: Get one Quality Patches Tool patch by id (e.g. "ACSD-56760") with every file variant, its Composer constraint, resolved applicable versions per distribution, modified files, prerequisites, documentation fields and the raw patch URL.

distribution.description: Optional distribution for installation. Defaults to magento-commerce when a live Commerce file applies to the version, otherwise magento-community.

version.description: Optional version: includes install instructions and a bundle URL for all applicable non-deprecated files, or composer null when none apply. Without a version, returns the bare entry.

name: get_patch
